A component that shows the current score and commentary.
Switchable sections, such as Your Team, Live Match and Scorecard.

used_by: Next.js route for /crews/[crewId]/match/[matchId] (no importing file visible)

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the match page
sections.what: Brings in the page helpers, the contest data functions, and three visual pieces: the team builder, the live match panel and the tabbed view.
sections.why: Needed to load data and draw the screens.

sections.name: MatchContestPage (part 1)
sections.title: Loading data and the locked-in view
sections.what: Loads the match and the member's saved team. If a team exists, shows a Locked In banner with both team names and the tabbed view for the team, live match and scorecard. Otherwise starts the builder heading.
sections.why: Likely reason: a saved team should not be edited, so the page shows results instead of the builder.
sections.watch_out: If myTeam is returned when a member has not picked yet, the builder will be skipped.

sections.name: MatchContestPage (part 2)
sections.title: Team builder and live match panel
sections.what: Loads the players for this crew and match, then draws the match title, a live tag when the match is in progress, a fixed 11-player instruction, the live panel, and the team builder with the toss status.
sections.why: Likely reason: the builder is the only action before a team is locked, so it fills the rest of the page.
sections.watch_out: The toss flag is passed to the builder, so a wrong match status changes which picks are allowed.

summary: The match page for a crew member: shows the team builder before a team is saved, and a locked-in view with tabs afterwards.
purpose: Lets a member pick eleven players for a match, then view their saved team, the live match and the scorecard.
why: Likely reason: a member builds one team, so the page changes to a read-only view once a team is saved.
how: Reads the crew and match ids, finds the signed-in user, and loads the match and any saved team. If a team exists, shows a Locked In banner and the tabbed view. Otherwise loads the available players and shows the team builder with the live match panel above it.
inputs: Crew id and match id from the address, the signed-in user, and data from getContest and builderPlayers.
outputs: Either a locked-in screen with tabs, or a builder page with the live match panel and the player selection.
risks: Once a team is saved, this page no longer offers the builder, so editing is not possible here. The live match panel is drawn before the builder, and this file shows no error handling of its own beyond the not-found helper.
debug: If the wrong view appears, check whether getContest returns a value for myTeam. If the player list is empty, check builderPlayers. If a Not Found page appears, check getContest.
